description: Natural Disaster Relief and Recovery Arrangements Activations is a dataset listed in Queensland Government open data portal (data.qld.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Queensland Reconstruction Authority. The Natural Disaster Relief and Recovery Arrangements (NDRRA) are a joint funding initiative of the Commonwealth and State Governments to provide disaster relief and recovery payments and infrastructure restoration to help communities recover from the effects of natural disasters. Coverage: Queensland. The portal files it under the publisher Queensland Reconstruction Authority. Its tags are Activations, Bushfires, Cyclones, Floods, GovHack 2018. It offers 48 resource(s) in pdf, xlsx. The portal shows 2022-02-02 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-queensland-government-open-data-portal.
